long_description.before: Zaymo is a full-stack retention marketing agency for the largest brands on Shopify. We bring all your data in house, remove the guess work, and automate the busy work. Agents find opportunities, build content, and iterate autonomously while expert retention marketers help you set strategy and oversee outputs.
long_description.after:
Zaymo builds the tools AI agents use to do marketing, for the largest ecommerce brands in the world. ~500 brands, including Grüns, Harry's, AG1 and Liquid I.V. (Unilever), run on Zaymo.

Our wedge is interactive email. We made emails work like websites: shoppers buy, swap or skip a subscription without leaving the inbox. It closes 75%+ of the brands we pitch and put us inside the email programs of hundreds of the best brands in ecommerce.

Now we're building the agents that run those programs. Brands pay agencies ~$70k a year to run email, and the good ones run one or two tests a month. Our agents audit the program, write and design on-brand campaigns, QA them, and run hundreds of experiments optimized for profit, not just revenue, with an expert human owning the outcome. We build for the agent a marketer already uses (Claude, via MCP), not yet another chatbot.

$5M ARR, 5x'ing this year, consistently cash-flow positive.

long_description.before: FutureClinic is a platform that makes it easy for any doctor to open their own digital clinic. Our AI assistant takes a comprehensive medical history using an empathic chat or voice-based interface, uses sophisticated medical reasoning to narrow down likely diagnoses, and produces evidence-based treatment suggestions for each patient. Licensed doctors then review the text-based summaries of the cases our AI provides, and choose how to manage the patients. In this fashion, we're able to deliver end-to-end healthcare in a way that makes personalized, expert healthcare scalable to 8 billion people around the world.
long_description.after:
FutureClinic is the world's largest agent-native medical clinic: over 300 doctors (generalists and specialists, covering over 63 specialty types) you can reach directly from Claude, ChatGPT or whichever AI agent you already use. 

Hundreds of millions of people use AI models to better understand their own health. But when it comes time to take that information and turn it into medical care, they're left going back to the broken healthcare system, waiting months for a rushed appointment, and feeling frustrated that their doctor doesn't have the time to digest the research they've done with their AI. 

Now, you can ask your AI to bring in a real doctor into that same conversation. A physician reads your whole case and answers you personally, typically within a few hours, and sends a live recorded video called a Human Signature with their response so you know you're getting real care from an expert every time.

They can diagnose, prescribe to the pharmacy you choose, order lab tests and even imaging when needed. A visit is $40, with no insurance, appointment or subscription needed, in 33 states and Washington, D.C. You can also start at futureclinic.com. 

For doctors, FutureClinic is the way to become a personal doctor to patients directly. Build your own AI-native clinic for free in under 3 minutes, get found by the AI agents patients already turn to for help, and set your own prices and hours. Malpractice coverage is included. It’s care on your terms, where you're in control, with no private equity owner or hospital system standing between you and your patients.

long_description.before:
Pickle is a personal AI agent that gets things done for you. Every user has their own Pickle, which they talk to by voice or chat. It works in its own cloud browser, signs in to the services you already use, and finishes everyday tasks end to end: ordering food, booking rides, flights and restaurant tables, shopping, sending money, and handling paperwork. It places phone calls on your behalf in 81 countries, sends a morning briefing, and runs scheduled tasks. Pickles also talk to each other, so you can send yours to a friend’s Pickle to settle a dinner plan or split a bill.

Every Pickle earns trust in steps, from small errands to the accounts, cards, and identity it needs to act for you. Credentials stay in a hardware-isolated enclave that neither the model nor our servers can read, every action goes to a log you can see in the app, and nothing is used to train models.

Pickle is live on the App Store in the US and launches in Korea next, as the first personal agent built for Korea’s identity checks, payment rails, and everyday services, with the aim of becoming the country’s national app.
long_description.after: Pickle is the personal AI agent network for Asia. Instead of building another chatbot or an overcrowded super-app, Pickle replaces daily life administration with an "invisible super-app" powered by autonomous background tool execution—handling restaurant bookings, store phone calls, delivery tracking, administrative paperwork, and local payments without user micromanagement. Because every user gets a dedicated agent with persistent memory and local context, Pickles naturally connect with one another: coordinating schedules between friends, exchanging local recommendations, and delegating shared errands. Driven by 70%+ D1 retention and strong organic viral loops (K-factor > 1.2), this creates an unprecedented Agent-to-Agent (A2A) network effect. Starting with Korea and Japan, Pickle integrates deeply with local messaging (Kakao, LINE), local identity, and payment rails to become the default consumer execution layer across 670M people in Asia.

one_liner.before: The personal AI agent for Korea.
one_liner.after: The personal AI agent network for Asia

long_description.before: Reason Machines builds Reason Agent, the autonomous software engineer for engineering teams. Reason connects to GitHub, reproduces bugs, writes code, passes tests, and ships review-ready pull requests with recordings and logs across cloud environments.
long_description.after:
Reason is an AI teammate for work and code that runs autonomous cloud agents with a frontier harness on cost per task.

It delivers the same performance with 22% lower costs than Codex. By operating with a harness outside the sandbox, it acts seamlessly across cloud computers and local devices.

Reason runs work from start to finish: from an issue to a finished pull request, on a schedule, or from a Slack alert. It is available as a Mac app, on the web, from the CLI, in Slack, and through a REST API, with about 100 integrations and shareable skills. Bring your own keys and subscriptions, and work rolls over to the next one when limits are hit.

long_description.before:
Manicule does AgentRel. We get companies discovered and used by AI agents. Think DevRel, rebuilt for a world where agents make all the decisions. We own developer documentation and technical content across social channels, end-to-end. We've grown 100% MoM over the last three months to $53K in monthly revenue, with customers like Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, and Mastra.
  
Getting discovered and used by agents is its own job now, and the market for it is broken. The SEO/GEO SaaS tools just show you data like where you rank in AI answers. The agencies are slow and lack know-how with agents. The one person who could own all of it end-to-end, a DevRel, is nearly impossible to hire: our customers have had roles open for months at $300K+ and still can't find anyone good. 

We solve all these gaps. Naman has been doing fractional DevRel since he was 13, working with companies like PromptLayer, Brightdata, and Courier.com. Shreyans has been building since 14 — he built an AI app that hit App Store Productivity Trending within a month, and
was the founding engineer at Supermemory. We met in high school and have built multiple startups together since.

OpenCrawl lets agents search over hard-to-find multimodal data.
Agents describe the data they need; OpenCrawl finds the sources, then builds and hosts custom crawlers, processing and search indexes. Teams use it to find answers across their own files, tools and legacy systems.
